attachments.text: TASK: 1. analysis the codes in ... first and think and plan 2. plan for the class with rich_tree_utils/ folder for riching base tree 3. use langgraph to build class structure for rich_base_tree for common use, with rich_base_tree_v1 exposed 1. use loguru please 2. !!!all import packages have been build, do not implement, just use try-except to import, such as : from content_tree_utils import ContentTreeUtil from utils.oss_utils import OSSUtil from utils.search_utils import SearchUtil from utils.llm_utils import llm_chat_retry from prompt.temp_prompt import RICH_SUBTREE_NODES_TEMPLATE, RICH_SUBTREE_TOPIC_TEMPLATE, RICH_ORI_NODE_POOL, GEN_NODE_SUMMARY_POOL, GEN_TOPIC_SUBTREE_POOL, NODE_REFERENCE_TEXT_POOL, ADD_NODE_SUBTREE_TEMPLATE, NODE_OUTPUT_TEMPLATE 3. build classes, notice private api use _ or __ to name 4. comments/docstrings are needed LLM_TOKENIZER = tiktoken.get_encoding("o200k_base") def rich_base_tree_v1(temp_tree, field, unique_id, temp_topic='', num_layers_rich=2): """对basetree进行拓展与丰富, 或者任意一个主题，大模型给出基本知识框架""" root_name = temp_tree['name'] tag_base_tree(temp_tree) # 先标记base max_level = min(3, max(node['level'] for node in get_node_list(temp_tree, with_level=True))) # new_tree = rich_base_tree_rec(temp_tree, temp_tree, field, root_name) # 递归进行拓展 # 先调整整体框架root num = 4 add_tree = gen_sub_topics(temp_tree, temp_tree, field, num) filter_tree_node_topic(temp_tree) base_tree = temp_tree # base_tree = rich_root_children(temp_tree, field, max_depth=2) # 旧逻辑 add_tree_url = OSSUtil.upload_file_to_oss(add_tree, "root_add_tree.json", f"ai/smart_brain_extractor/tree/{unique_id}") tree_url = OSSUtil.upload_file_to_oss(temp_tree, "base_tree.json", f"ai/smart_brain_extractor/tree/{unique_id}") logger.debug(f"【{root_name}】root_add_tree: {add_tree_url}。base_tree: {tree_url}") # 子树框架 (3+2) try: # tree_url = 'https://yufa-polymas.oss-cn-hangzhou-internal.aliyuncs.com/ai/smart_brain_extractor/tree/39454dfcfa6a1a0351437e0b1d0da294/base_tree.json' # base_tree = OSSUtil.get_data_by_oss_url(tree_url) max_depth = max_level for depth in tqdm(range(1, max_level+1), desc='逐层级拓展'): print("*"*50, f"【{root_name}】开始处理第{depth}层子树框架", "*"*50) logger.info(f"【{root_name}】开始处理第{depth}层子树框架") node_list = get_node_list(base_tree, with_level=True, with_path=True) node_list = [node for node in node_list if node['level'] == depth] process_subtrees_v1(node_list, base_tree, field, root_name, max_depth) filter_tree_node_topic(base_tree) # 过滤掉总结 base_tree = get_level2_tree(base_tree, level=0, max_depth=max_depth + 2) # 限制层级，只要前n层 except Exception as e: logger.error(f"【{root_name}】基础框架拓展失败，异常信息{e}：{traceback.format_exc()}") # file_path = r'E:\0 智慧树_work\1 pythonProject1\KG\smart-brain-extractor\data\base_tree\final_base_tree_v1.json' # write_json_file(base_tree, file_path) tree_url = OSSUtil.upload_file_to_oss(base_tree, "final_base_tree.json", f"ai/smart_brain_extractor/tree/{unique_id}") logger.debug(f"【{root_name}】final_base_tree: {tree_url}") return base_tree def get_level2_tree(temp_tree, level=0, max_depth=2): """ 生成一个最大深度为 max_depth 的树结构""" if max_depth == -1: return copy.deepcopy(temp_tree) new_tree = copy.deepcopy(temp_tree) new_tree['children'] = [] if level >= max_depth: return new_tree if 'children' in temp_tree and temp_tree['children']: for child in temp_tree['children']: # 递归处理子节点 new_child = get_level2_tree(child, level + 1, max_depth) new_tree['children'].append(new_child) return new_tree def process_subtrees_v1(node_list, base_tree, field, root_name, max_depth): """按照新增节点与原始节点，分别进行子树构建： 原始节点子树拓展思路：先确定拓展的子主题（即新增子节点），再检索资源，再生成新子树 """ add_node_list = [node for node in node_list if node['tag'] == 'add'] ori_node_list = [node for node in node_list if node['tag'] == 'base'] if add_node_list: get_node_reference_text({}, field, add_node_list) # 检索资源 rich_add_tree(add_node_list, base_tree, field, root_name, max_depth=max_depth) if ori_node_list: rich_ori_node_list(ori_node_list, base_tree, field, root_name, max_depth=max_depth) def rich_add_tree(node_list, base_tree, field, root_name, max_depth=2): """新增主题的子树拓展""" param_dict = {"aliases": [], "description": "", "type": 0, "labels": [], "parent_relation": "", "parent_relation_desc": "", "sourceList": [], "children": []} # with global_lock: base_name_list = [node['name']for node in get_node_list(base_tree)] task_dict = {} with tqdm(total=len(node_list), desc="Rich_add_tree", mininterval=2) as pbar: for node in node_list: if node.get('children', []): continue task = GEN_TOPIC_SUBTREE_POOL.submit(gen_add_node_subtree_llm, node, base_name_list, field, max_depth) task_dict[task] = node for task in as_completed(task_dict.keys()): node = task_dict[task] res = task.result() if res: for param, v in param_dict.items(): node[param] = res.get(param, v) tag_base_tree(node, tag='add') pbar.update(1) # 每完成一个任务，更新进度条 def gen_add_node_subtree_llm(node, name_list, field, max_depth): topic = node['name'] try: node_path = node['upstream_path'] reference_text_list = node['reference_text_list'] temp_prompt = ADD_NODE_SUBTREE_TEMPLATE.format(topic=topic, field=field, context=node_path, existing_nodes=name_list) + NODE_OUTPUT_TEMPLATE user_content = json.dumps({"参考的文本": reference_text_list}, ensure_ascii=False) res_llm = llm_chat_retry(messages=[ {"role": "system", "content": temp_prompt}, {"role": "user", "content": user_content}], max_len=128000, model='gpt-4.1-mini') if res_llm: return res_llm return {} except Exception as e: logger.error(f'【{topic}】主题-生成子树--大模型生成失败，异常信息【{e}】：{traceback.format_exc()}') return {} def get_node_reference_text(temp_tree, field, temp_node_list=[]): """生成节点相关文本""" task_dict = {} node_list = temp_node_list if temp_node_list else get_node_list(temp_tree, with_path=True) # temp_tree只能是全树，不能是某个自己的，不然上游路径不对 for node in node_list: get_node_search_text(node, field) search_text = node.get('search_text', node['name']) task = NODE_REFERENCE_TEXT_POOL.submit(get_search_resource, search_text) task_dict[task] = node # for task in as_completed(task_dict.keys()): for task in tqdm(as_completed(task_dict.keys()), desc="处理任务（检索资源）", total=len(task_dict)): node = task_dict[task] resource_dict, resource_text_list = task.result() node['reference_text_list'] = check_reference_text_length(resource_text_list) node['reference_dict'] = resource_dict def get_node_search_text(temp_tree, field): """获取节点的检索文本""" task_dict = {} node_list = get_node_list(temp_tree, with_path=True) # with_path=True for node in node_list: node_chain = node['upstream_path'] node_name = node['name'] node['search_text'] = node['upstream_path'] # 默认 task = GEN_NODE_SUMMARY_POOL.submit(SearchUtil.search_text_summary_llm, node_chain, node_name, field) task_dict[task] = node for task in as_completed(task_dict.keys()): # for task in tqdm(as_completed(task_dict.keys()), desc="处理任务（提炼search文本）", total=len(task_dict)): node = task_dict[task] try: res = task.result() node['search_text'] = res.get('new_name', node['upstream_path']) except Exception as e: logger.error(f"【{node['name']}】检索文本的提炼--大模型生成失败，异常信息【{e}】：{traceback.format_exc()}") def rich_ori_node_list(node_list, base_tree, field, root_name, num=6, max_depth=2): """原始节点拓展子树： 先确定拓展的子主题，再检索资源，再生成新子树""" task_list = [] for node in node_list: task = RICH_ORI_NODE_POOL.submit(rich_ori_node, node, base_tree, field, root_name, num, max_depth) task_list.append(task) wait(task_list) def rich_ori_node(node, base_tree, field, root_name, num, max_depth): """原始节点下的-新增节点的子树拓展""" # 先确定拓展的子主题，再检索资源，再生成新子树 temp_num = max(2, num - node['level']) gen_sub_topics(node, base_tree, field, num=temp_num, rich_with_llm=False) filter_tree_node_topic(node) # 剔除非知识点主题 get_node_list(base_tree, with_path=True, with_level=True) # 为了给新增节点都标记上游路径 add_node_list = [nd for nd in node['children'] if nd['tag'] == 'add'] if add_node_list: get_node_reference_text({}, field, add_node_list) # 检索资源 rich_add_tree(add_node_list, base_tree, field, root_name, max_depth=max_depth) def check_reference_text_length(temp_text_list, max_token=120000, retry=10): """检查节点相关文本长度，返回最大长度的有效文本""" if not temp_text_list: logger.warning("输入文本列表为空，直接返回空列表") return [] token_num = len(LLM_TOKENIZER.encode(json.dumps(temp_text_list, ensure_ascii=False))) if token_num <= max_token: # logger.info("整个文本列表的 token 数未超过限制，直接返回完整列表") return temp_text_list left = 0 right = len(temp_text_list) best_idx = len(temp_text_list) retry_threshold = 1 while left <= right and retry > 0: mid = (left + right) // 2 token_num = len(LLM_TOKENIZER.encode(json.dumps(temp_text_list[:mid], ensure_ascii=False))) if token_num <= max_token: best_idx = mid left = mid + 1 else: right = mid - 1 # 终止条件：left 和 right 的差值小于阈值 if right - left < retry_threshold: logger.debug("查找范围已足够小，提前终止") break retry -= 1 if retry <= 0: logger.warning("文本长度截断失败，已达到最大重试次数") return temp_text_list[:best_idx] def get_search_resource(search_text): """检索资源""" # print(f'开始检索---》【{search_text}】') searcher = SearchUtil() res1, _ = searcher.get_open_domain_rag_data(search_text) # 开放域 res2, _ = searcher.get_knowledge_block_recommend_data(search_text, kb_ids=["rw3uQo9Uy7"]) # 知识库 resource_dict, resource_text_list = get_resource_text(res1, res2) if res1: logger.debug(f"开放域检索：【{search_text}】- 返回数据{len(res1)}条！") # print(f"开放域检索：【{search_text}】- 返回数据{len(res1)}条！") if res2: logger.debug(f"知识块检索：【{search_text}】- 返回数据{len(res2)}条！") # print(f"知识块检索：【{search_text}】- 返回数据{len(res2)}条！") return resource_dict, resource_text_list def get_resource_text(res1, res2): """汇总检索资源的文本数据""" res_list, resource_dict, clean_resource_list = [], {}, [] if res1: for result in res1: # ['data']['resultList'] # if result['similarity'] > 0.9: res_list.append(result) if res2: for result in res2: # ['data']['resultList'] if result['similarity'] > 0.9: res_list.append(result) for result in res_list: new_res = { "title": result['block_title'], "sourceId": result["source_id"], "sourceName": result['source_name'], "sourceType": result["resource_type_en"], "id": result['id'], "segId": result["segId"], 'url': result["paper_url"], 'name': result["paper_title"], } uid = get_md5_id(new_res['name'] + new_res['url']) resource_dict[uid] = new_res clean_res = { 'name': result["paper_title"], 'url': result["paper_url"], 'text': result["paper_text"], } clean_resource_list.append(clean_res) return resource_dict, clean_resource_list def gen_sub_topics(temp_tree, target_tree, field, num=3, rich_with_llm=True): """子主题的拓展""" topic = temp_tree['name'] add_tree = gen_subtopic_with_reference_text(temp_tree, num, field) # 基于参考文本 child_name_list = [node['name'] for node in get_node_list(target_tree)] + [node['name'] for node in get_node_list(add_tree)] child_name_list = list(set(child_name_list)) if rich_with_llm: llm_res = gen_subtopic_with_llm(topic, child_name_list, num-1, field) # 大模型自己拓展 if llm_res: sub_topic_node = check_topic_unique(child_name_list, llm_res["new_subtopics"]) add_tree['children'].extend(sub_topic_node) tag_base_tree(add_tree, tag='add') # 标记新增 child_name_list = [node['name'] for node in add_tree['children']] temp_tree['children'].extend(add_tree['children']) # 合并 logger.debug(f'【{topic}】拓展的子主题数有{len(add_tree["children"])}个: {child_name_list}') print(f'【{topic}】拓展的子主题数有{len(add_tree["children"])}个: \n {child_name_list}') return add_tree # , temp_tree def check_topic_unique(old_topics, new_topics): """检查topic是否唯一""" unique_topics = [] for item in new_topics: if item['name'] in old_topics: continue unique_topics.append(item) return unique_topics def gen_subtopic_with_llm(topic, child_name_list, n, field): """根据大模型生成子主题-拓展""" try: temp_prompt = RICH_SUBTREE_TOPIC_TEMPLATE .format(field=field, topic=topic, existing_subtopics=child_name_list, n=n) user_content = '开始拓展子主题吧！' llm_res = llm_chat_retry(messages=[ {"role": "system", "content": temp_prompt}, {"role": "user", "content": user_content}], max_len=128000, model='gpt-4.1') if llm_res: return llm_res return {} except Exception as e: logger.error(f'【{topic}】根节点拓展主题llm--大模型生成失败，异常信息【{e}】：{traceback.format_exc()}') return {} def gen_subtopic_with_reference_text(temp_tree, num, field): """根据参考文本生成子主题""" topic = temp_tree['name'] add_tree = copy.deepcopy(temp_tree) add_tree['children'] = [] child_node_list = [] # 暂时没用上 for node in temp_tree['children']: new_child = {'name': node['name'], 'aliases': node['aliases'], 'labels': node['labels'], 'description': node['description']} child_node_list.append(new_child) reference_text = temp_tree['reference_text_list'] name_list = list(set([node['name'] for node in get_node_list(temp_tree)])) child_name_list = list(set([node['name'] for node in temp_tree['children']])) # temp_tree['children'] llm_res = rich_root_child_llm(topic, child_name_list, name_list, reference_text, num, field) # 主题拓展 if llm_res: # temp_tree['children'].extend(llm_res["new_subtopics"]) subtree = check_topic_unique(child_name_list, llm_res["new_subtopics"]) add_tree['children'] = subtree return add_tree def rich_root_child_llm(topic, existing_children, name_list, reference_text, n, field): try: temp_prompt = RICH_SUBTREE_NODES_TEMPLATE.format(field=field, topic=topic, existing_subtopics=existing_children, n=n, name_list=name_list) user_content = json.dumps({"相关长文本信息": reference_text}, ensure_ascii=False) # user_content = '开始拓展子主题吧！' llm_res = llm_chat_retry(messages=[ {"role": "system", "content": temp_prompt}, {"role": "user", "content": user_content}], max_len=128000, model='gpt-4.1') if llm_res: return llm_res return {} except Exception as e: logger.error(f'【{topic}】根节点拓展主题--大模型生成失败，异常信息【{e}】：{traceback.format_exc()}') return {} def tag_base_tree(temp_tree, tag='base'): """对base tree节点作上标记,区分原始与拓展""" if 'tag' not in temp_tree: temp_tree['tag'] = tag if 'children' in temp_tree and temp_tree['children']: for child in temp_tree['children']: tag_base_tree(child, tag) def get_node_list(tree, path=None, with_path=False, temp_level=0, with_level=False): if path is None: path = [] if with_path: path = path + [tree['name']] tree['upstream_path'] = '->'.join(path) if with_level: tree['level'] = temp_level node_list = [tree] if 'children' in tree and tree['children']: for child in tree['children']: node_list += get_node_list(child, path.copy(), with_path, temp_level + 1, with_level) return node_list def filter_tree_node_topic(temp_tree): """过滤掉非主题的节点""" filter_words = ['总结', '小结', '示例'] new_topic_node = [] for node in temp_tree['children']: should_filter = False for word in filter_words: if word in node['name']: should_filter = True break if not should_filter: new_topic_node.append(node) temp_tree['children'] = new_topic_node
